summary.intent: Monitor PR #349 for incoming bot reviews (CodeRabbit, Copilot) and automatically resolve them, then investigate a session restore E2E test failure discovered during the process and fix the underlying race conditions.
summary.outcome: All 23 review threads on PR #349 resolved across 4 rounds with real bug fixes committed; two new PRs created (#350 for session restore race conditions, #351 for vault init duplicate key bug) and merged; staging performance baselines captured; desktop E2E test failure root-caused and fixed.

repo: Recovery script (apps/web/public/recovery.html) was using the vault key IPNS name for root folder traversal — IPNS derivation for vault key and root folder must use separate keypairs/constants
useAuth.ts getVault() 404 catch was too broad — caught IPFS fetch 404s unrelated to vault existence, misclassifying existing users as new
vault.service.ts initializeVault() had a TOCTOU race: findOne check + insert were not in a transaction, allowing concurrent requests to both pass the existence check

The IPNS publish endpoint (ipns.service.ts) creates folder_ipns rows on first publish, so POST /vault/init must not also try to insert for the same IPNS name — PR #349 introduced this sequencing bug by publishing before calling /vault/init
Web3Auth Core Kit DKG on Sapphire Devnet dominates login time (~9-45s); our vault-critical serial path is ~720ms (auth/login + GET /vault + IPNS resolve)
Auth/refresh is called directly (not via 401 interceptor) in session restore — 6 concurrent refresh calls observed on page reload, bypassing Axios interceptor deduplication
initializeOrLoadVault useCallback can be called concurrently from multiple React effect cycles on session restore, causing double vault init

code.finding: directRootIpnsName variable was actually the vault key IPNS name but was used for root folder traversal — needed separate derivation for each
Broad try/catch around entire vault load including fetchFromIpfs — 404 from IPFS (missing CID) would incorrectly trigger vault re-initialization for existing users
Module-level vaultInitPromise deduplication guard added — prevents concurrent initializeOrLoadVault executions from racing to double-init vault
authApi.refresh() direct calls not deduplicated — added module-level refreshPromise so concurrent session restore effects collapse to a single in-flight request
Replaced findOne + conditional save TOCTOU with optimistic insert + catch on PG error code 23505 (unique_violation), then falls back to update isRoot — race-safe and saves a DB round-trip
IPNS publish endpoint creates folder_ipns rows on first publish — vault/init must not assume it needs to create this row, causing duplicate key constraint violations
slice() was used instead of subarray() — subarray() is zero-copy for Uint8Array operations

workflow: CronCreate with /loop skill enables fully automated PR review monitoring — bot reviews get auto-resolved without manual intervention
outside-diff-range comments don't appear as reviewThreads in GraphQL API — must be fetched via review body separately
Playwright native page.on('request'/'response') events are more reliable for network monitoring than injected fetch patches that don't survive navigation
installMockWallet from @johanneskares/wallet-mock handles full EIP-6963 provider with real secp256k1 signing for E2E wallet login tests
Coverage thresholds can be broken by adding new uncovered branches — optimistic insert + catch requires a test simulating PG duplicate key error (code 23505)
markdownlint runs in CI on all markdown files — failing lint (prettier) on perf scripts committed to the repo requires fixing before CI passes
Desktop E2E tests can be skipped when no relevant changes detected — need to verify actual passing run, not skipped run, when debugging regressions

friction: GitHub API GraphQL timed out on one poll cycle — handled gracefully but could cause missed review windows
outside-diff-range Copilot comments are not surfaced as reviewThreads — required manual URL to discover them
1Password SSH agent unavailable during one commit attempt while user was AFK — required retry after user returned
Playwright MCP sandbox doesn't support Node module imports (dynamic import fails) — had to fall back to standalone .mjs script via Bash
Web3Auth OTP flow on staging requires real credentials — test-login API bypass needed for perf measurement
Staging DB was wiped so no existing vaults available for IPNS resolve baseline — had to create vault via wallet login first
Auth/refresh race condition on session restore fired 6 concurrent refresh calls with 2 returning 401 — noise in logs complicated diagnosis
Pre-existing TypeScript error in vault.service.spec.ts caused typecheck noise unrelated to changes
open_items: Post-deploy re-measurement: run staging-perf-wallet.mjs after PR #349 deploys to get real IPNS resolve + IPFS fetch numbers with live vault key blob
Auth/refresh race produces 401s on 2 of 6 concurrent calls — the shared-Promise fix prevents concurrent calls but the root cause (multiple effects firing) should be investigated
vault.service.ts initializeVault() still lacks a database transaction wrapping the vault + folder_ipns inserts — deferred as over-engineering for once-per-user-lifetime operation
Session restore with Core Kit requires full re-initialization on page reload (tKey shares not persisted in Playwright browser context) — true session restore baseline not yet captured
Desktop E2E test coverage for vault init duplicate key path (the new catch block in vault.service.ts) relies on E2E rather than unit tests
